observations: Three photos show a large, beige-colored office machine wrapped in clear plastic.
The machine has a top cover and a front panel with a control interface.
The machine appears to be a multifunction printer or copier, with visible paper trays labeled 'A4' and 'A3'.
The plastic wrap is crinkled and covers the entire unit, obscuring details of the front panel and control buttons.
No power cord, paper tray, or other accessories are visible in the photos.
The watermark 'SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT' is present on all photos, suggesting a reseller or distributor.

claims.claim: The AR-M207 is packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions
claims.evidence: The photos show the machine wrapped in plastic, and no internal components or control panel are visible. The claim about 'superb performance functions' cannot be verified from the images alone.

risks.risk: The machine may be non-functional or have internal damage not visible through the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine unboxed, showing the control panel, paper trays, and power cord, with the machine powered on and in operation.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing essential accessories such as paper, toner, or power adapter.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the machine.

risks.risk: The machine may be a refurbished or used unit with hidden wear or damage.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the control panel, paper trays, and internal components, showing no signs of damage or wear.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown condition

proof_requests: Photo of the machine unboxed, showing the control panel, paper trays, and power cord.
Photo of all included accessories (paper, toner, power adapter, etc.).
Close-up of the control panel and internal components to verify condition.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
